dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge, forming a smooth spline from the posterior insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape with a wide pixel radius; lacks acute tapering at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior slope relative to the horizontal plane of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide base-to-height ratio, approximately 1.8:1 width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, wide-radius convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak profile with low longitudinal extension relative to the vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle visible where the melon curvature meets the superior plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan-green bioluminescent or artificial color profile across the entire visible cutaneous surface.
